verdict.rationale: Turso docs explicitly document PITR to restore a database to a specific point in time to recover from user errors like accidental drops, plus branching (including from-db) to create isolated copies for testing recovery scenarios. No independent/hands-on corroboration of PITR specifically was found, and retention window limits/pricing tiers for PITR aren't detailed. missing for 10: independent verification of PITR working in practice, explicit retention-window duration/limits per plan.
